import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0","Accept":"application/json"}
OUT="/agent/jobs/7561709a-580d-4fd2-935d-b3d405b23f50/provenance"

ph=pd.read_csv(f"{OUT}/GAT2_sgd_phenotypes.csv")
KW=["nitrogen","ammoni","glutamine","proline","urea ","allantoin","rapamycin","dal5","catabolite"]
def hit(r):
    blob=" ".join(str(x) for x in r.values).lower()
    return [k for k in KW if k in blob]
ph["nitrogen_terms"]=ph.apply(hit,axis=1)
n=(ph.nitrogen_terms.map(len)>0).sum()
print(f"GAT2 SGD phenotypes mentioning nitrogen/NCR/rapamycin terms (corrected word matching): {n} of {len(ph)}")
print("Distinct phenotype classes recorded:")
print(ph.phenotype.value_counts().to_string())

# ---------- consolidated motif-discrimination table (all three motif classes the seed hypothesis proposes) ----------
summary=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(motif_class="classical NLS (K/R)(K/R)X(K/R)", ScGat2_observed=0, null_mean=0.40, p_vs_null=0.66,
      ortholog_range="0-3", Gat2_vs_NCR_U=8.0, Gat2_vs_NCR_p=0.437, discriminates="no"),
 dict(motif_class="bipartite NLS", ScGat2_observed=1, null_mean=np.nan, p_vs_null=np.nan,
      ortholog_range="0-2", Gat2_vs_NCR_U=np.nan, Gat2_vs_NCR_p=np.nan, discriminates="no (sole hit is inside folded ZF, pLDDT 97)"),
 dict(motif_class="leucine-rich NES", ScGat2_observed=4, null_mean=4.34, p_vs_null=0.605,
      ortholog_range="1-5", Gat2_vs_NCR_U=10.0, Gat2_vs_NCR_p=0.762, discriminates="no"),
 dict(motif_class="Ser-rich tract (max %S, 50aa)", ScGat2_observed=22.0, null_mean=np.nan, p_vs_null=np.nan,
      ortholog_range="18-34%", Gat2_vs_NCR_U=np.nan, Gat2_vs_NCR_p=np.nan, discriminates="no (Cg ortholog 34% vs Gln3 36%)"),
])
summary.to_csv(f"{OUT}/motif_discrimination_summary.csv",index=False)
print("\n=== Can the seed hypothesis's proposed scans discriminate Gat2 from Gln3/Gat1? ===")
print(summary.to_string(index=False))

# ---------- final figure: all motif classes vs null ----------
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9.5,4.4))
lab=["classical NLS","leucine-rich NES"]
obs_g2=[0,4]; null_g2=[0.40,4.34]; sd_g2=[0.63,2.27]
x=np.arange(2)
ax.bar(x-0.19,null_g2,yerr=sd_g2,width=0.36,color="#B9BEC7",capsize=4,label="composition-matched null for Gat2")
ax.bar(x+0.19,obs_g2,width=0.36,color="#C1553B",label="observed in Gat2")
for i,(o,nm,p) in enumerate(zip(obs_g2,null_g2,[0.66,0.605])):
    ax.text(i,max(o,nm+sd_g2[i])+0.35,f"p = {p}",ha="center",fontsize=10)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(lab); ax.set_ylabel("motif matches in Gat2 (560 aa)")
ax.set_title("Neither motif scan proposed by the hypothesis departs from chance expectation for Gat2\n"
             "Gat2 orthologs vs NCR GATA factors: NLS p = 0.44, NES density p = 0.76 (Mann-Whitney)",fontsize=10,loc="left")
ax.legend(frameon=False,fontsize=9)
for sp in ("top","right"): ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
